claims.heading: 老年人流感死亡负担
claims.text: 中国2010–11至2014–15季节的模型估计中，≥60岁人群流感相关超额呼吸死亡率为38.5例/10万人季，<60岁为1.5例/10万人季；95%CI分别为36.8–40.2和1.1–1.9。
claims.approvedCaption:
≥60岁死亡率较高
中国2010–15年估计
claims.reviewNote: 2026-10-13独立核对原文Table1的All influenza列，并与Results中年龄分层段落和PubMed Findings交叉核对：<60岁点估计1.5、95%CI1.1–1.9；≥60岁点估计38.5、95%CI36.8–40.2。图中values是真实报告的平均每季超额呼吸死亡率模型点估计，不是由上下界推算的midpoint。人口为中国大陆，季节范围为2010–11至2014–15，流感A/B合计；不是A型单独死亡率，也不是当前年度统计。标题和caption仅比较原文的人群超额呼吸死亡率，不把死亡率、人数、全因死亡或天然产物临床疗效混为一谈。原文为观察性人群统计建模研究，非治疗试验。
claims.locator: Table1: Average annual influenza-associated excess respiratory mortality rate, All influenza column, <60 y and ≥60 y rows; Results age-specific paragraph (NCBI BioC offset15086); PubMed abstract Findings.
claims.population: Mainland China; 2010–11 through2014–15 influenza seasons; age<60 and≥60; influenzaA/B combined; surveillance-linked statistical excess-mortality model.
claims.endpoint: Average seasonal influenza-associated excess respiratory mortality rate per100000 person-seasons; model point estimates and95%confidence intervals.

claims.heading: 现药临床获益
claims.text: CAPSTONE-1中，巴洛沙韦组症状缓解中位时间53.7小时，安慰剂组80.2小时；该非复杂流感门诊试验不能据此证明重症获益或天然产物疗效。
claims.reviewNote: 2026-10-13独立核对PubMed Results及NEJM主论文索引全文Figure 2图注：两组为53.7（95%CI 49.5–58.5）及80.2（72.6–87.1）小时，Figure 2可评价数分别455及230。首作者、题名、2018年卷期页、DOI与PubMed/Crossref匹配。主张、柱数据及caption均限于症状缓解中位时间；未以中位数重建生存曲线，未将一般健康非复杂流感门诊患者外推至重症，亦不视为植物天然产物证据。
claims.locator: NEJM Results → Phase 3 Trial → Clinical and Virologic Efficacy; Figure 2 caption; Methods → Outcomes Measured; PubMed abstract Results.
claims.approvedCaption:
症状缓解中位时间
53.7 vs 80.2小时
非复杂流感门诊试验
claims.population: CAPSTONE-1 phase III RCT: otherwise healthy outpatients aged12–64 in US/Japan, 2016–2017 season, acute uncomplicated influenza; ITTI n=1064; flu A/B combined, mainly A(H3N2).
claims.endpoint: Time from trial treatment initiation until all seven influenza-related symptoms were absent or mild for at least21.5 hours; median time, hours.

visual.footnote: 可评价n=455/230；门诊非复杂流感，不代表重症或天然产物疗效。

claims.heading: 效应必须结合毒性解释
claims.text: Hour等报告的黄芩素体外选择性比值为2.5和2.3；这属于特定体外读出，不能作临床治疗窗。
claims.approvedCaption:
黄芩素选择性比值
2.5与2.3
文献结果，非NP数据
claims.reviewNote: Checked Table4 baicalein row and the authors therapeutic-index definition. The reported dimensionless ratios are2.5 for seasonal2007 H1N1 and2.3 for pandemic2009 H1N1. These are different H1N1 backgrounds, not H1N1-versus-H3N2. No concentrations, operating conditions, growth parameters or per-patient results are reproduced. The ratio is a high-level preclinical selectivity measure, not a clinical therapeutic window and not userNP data.
